content:
Recently I tried several new MagSafe wallets, looking for one that looks more like a traditional wallet. Vinich's MagSafe wallet is the latest one I've tried, offering over 15 colour choices, looking like a traditional bifold wallet, designed to attach to the back of a leather iPhone, not clashing with a protective case, and looking more like an extension of your iPhone case.

MagSafe Monday：每個星期一，Bradley Chambers 都會為大家介紹 MagSafe 同無線充電市場嘅最新產品，幫你好好發揮你嘅無線充電 Apple 裝置嘅功能。

Colour options

The manufacturer has clearly put a lot of effort into colours, offering black, green, brown, and even purple among many other choices, all with a vintage patina, complementing a leather case rather than competing with it. There are also many other colours to choose from. Vinich also makes a desert titanium colour, which is perfect if you use your phone without a case, bare.

Wallet storage

Vinich states it has three card slots, and says depending on card thickness you can actually fit three to five cards. For everyday use, you might put your ID, one or two credit cards, and a company access card. Behind the cards there's also space to fold in one or two banknotes — this feature I really love in a small wallet — I try to keep about USD 20 in cash on me.

The card slots use RFID-blocking material inside, and the interior is lined with microfibre so your cards don't constantly rub against the fabric. The magnet is strong enough — though I've used stronger ones, and also much weaker ones.

Three things to know before you buy

First, this is synthetic leather, not genuine leather. It has a scratch-resistant construction and reinforced stitching, which is reasonable at this price point, but if you want to match it with a genuine leather case, note that the two materials won't look exactly identical. Vinich recommends conditioning it every three to six months.

Second, when taking photos with the wide-angle or macro lens, the wallet may slowly creep into frame. On most iPhones the wallet hangs below the lens, but if you're shooting close-ups, it's best to remove it first to ensure it doesn't cover the lens at all.

Third, it can't function as a stand, even though it may look like it could. The cover is intentionally designed to be relatively soft so the magnetic ring isn't under stress, so if you're looking for a wallet that doubles as a stand to prop up your iPhone for calls or video, this one isn't for you.

Conclusion

Priced under USD 25, if you've been using a decent leather case but can't find a matching wallet, the colour options alone are worth a look. Most MagSafe wallets aim for an "invisible" look, but this one is designed to complement other accessories, and looks and feels more like a traditional wallet you'd take out and use on its own. In the future, it would be perfect if Find My tracking could be added.

You can buy this Vinich MagSafe wallet on Amazon or directly from the Vinich website.
